test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Music is helpful in improving the _______ of students.
solution:
The correct answer is **'concentration'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look into the **meaning** of the given options - 

 
 
• **attraction - **the action or power of evoking interest in or liking for someone or something.
 
• **concentration - **the action or power of focusing all one's attention.
 
• **transfiguration - **a complete change of form or appearance into a more beautiful or spiritual state.
 
• **solution - **a means of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that **concentration **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as students need to concentrate to retain what they learn. 
 
• So, **option 2 **is the correct answer. 

**Correct sentence__ - ***Music is helpful in improving the __**concentration**__** **of students.*
